name: strategy
description: Build, evaluate, and evolve named strategies. Define canonical strategy references, configure information sources, run briefings that surface opportunities, and maintain a prioritized opportunity registry — privately or shared with collaborators. v1.1.3: hard-gate amendment — pointer writes verify grants via the outcome file OR an independent aifs_get_permissions read (helper ≤0.4.0 raced page-close writing outcome files, bug 20260605-62a14c43; fixed in helper 0.4.1, fallback retained as defense in depth). v1.1.2: companion to core 3.9.0 My Drive member spaces — prose updates only (member space = Agent-Index-Private in the owner's own My Drive; owner-applied grants now permitted because the owner owns the folder; member_folder_id self-provisions via @ai:update Migration 2, admin backfill retired; soft-delete nuance). Requires agent-index-core 3.9.0+. v1.1.1: helper-spec fix from test-plan §3 — share/unshare specs now use the bare id:{folder_id} resource form (the exact strategy folder's Drive ID; requires permission-helper-go 0.4.0+ which adds ID-anchor validation/resolution), and pointer writes are hard-gated on the helper outcome file reporting applied (never on assumed success — a premature pointer advertises access that doesn't exist). v1.1.0: owned-content sharing model — shared strategy content lives in the owner's private member space (addressed via ID anchors, id:{member_folder_id}/strategies/{slug}/) and is shared per-person via permission-change-helper grants: share = read, collaborator = read+write, share-with-org = all@ reader. Discovery via a pointer index at /shared/strategies-index/ (one JSON pointer per shared strategy; folder granted all@ writer via collaborative-acls.json at install Step 5.5). Replaces the /shared/strategies/ directory and strategies-manifest.json. Soft-delete/unshare conventions per core standards. Requires agent-index-core 3.8.0+ (member_folder_id) and filesystem adapter 2.5.0+ (ID anchors). Addresses the strategy row of the cross-collection access audit.
